title: Nothing on the public site leads to the store
why_needed: The CMS navigation (content/initial-content.json nav: الرئيسية … المَشَاهِد، تواصل) has no store entry; grep of src outside the admin finds href="/store" only in CartView.tsx:198 and CheckoutForm.tsx:475, pages a visitor reaches from the store itself; the book page links no product (DSN-PAGES-08) and the footer links only المَشاهد and تواصل. I41's hosted bootstrap list (social, scenes, book page, home doors, contact page) does not add one. When checkout opens, the store is reachable only by typed URL.
touches: site_settings.nav (admin or the P11 content bootstrap, I41), content/initial-content.json, src/components/public/book/BookView.tsx editions, src/components/public/rooms/ShelfRoomView.tsx (the shelf's products), src/components/site/Footer.tsx
package: P11 (content bootstrap) with the book-page change in a P08 residual round

title: The store's policies are linked only from the checkout sentence, the availability form and the order page
why_needed: grep of src finds /policies/ links only in AvailabilityForm.tsx:194, CheckoutForm.tsx:518 and OrderPage.tsx:285; the footer on every page (Footer.tsx) has no policy link, and the product page, the cart and the contact form (which collects name, e-mail and message; I43 parks its privacy link on E08) have none. A buyer cannot read the delivery or refund terms before adding to the cart, and nobody can find the privacy policy from a page that collects data.
touches: src/components/site/Footer.tsx (a «السياسات» row or the four links beside المَشاهد and تواصل), src/components/store product and cart pages, src/components/public/contact/ContactForm.tsx once E08 approves
package: a P08 residual round (or P10's design audit)

title: Policy pages show no revision or date, although checkout binds each order to a policy revision
why_needed: P08-CONTRACT section 6 records the seq of each policy a buyer accepts (policyRevisions), and a republish changes the text buyers see (X1.1), but /policies/<slug> (policies/[slug]/page.tsx) prints only the title and body: no «آخر تحديث», no revision. In a dispute neither the buyer nor Anas can tell from the page which text applied to an order; published_documents already carries the seq and updated_at (migration 20260925120000, lines 72-81).
touches: src/lib/policies.ts (select updated_at with doc_id,data,seq; anon already reads every column), src/app/(public)/policies/[slug]/page.tsx (one «آخر تحديث: …» line formatted with formatDate)
